title: Yanshi Agent API v1.1 additive compatibility fixture
description: Additive v1.1 overlay over v1. D1 currently emits only 'v1'; this document lets SDK tests prove forward compatibility with a future minor version that adds fields without changing required ones. Not served by D1. The allOf carries TWO branches on purpose: the $ref to v1 supplies the whole contract, and the local #/$defs/Item ref is what makes this document's own delta apply. Without that second branch the delta is unreachable — v1's internal #/$defs/Item resolves in v1's $id scope and never reaches here, so reasoningTokens: -5 validated clean.

Item.description: Applied unconditionally by the allOf above. It declares no required properties and allows additional ones, so it constrains exactly one thing: if reasoningTokens is present anywhere in the envelope it must be a non-negative integer. That is the shape an additive minor version has.
